Scope Gate.decided_by: CEO vuhoangcao (owner), recorded by the MC-17 orchestrator session: decision record entry CEO-D-1310
Scope Gate.rationale: CEO approved the scope as stated (S-001..S-018, X-001..X-011, A-001..A-030). Q-001: web app listens on 127.0.0.1 only, no outbound, toolchain keeps zero sockets. Q-002: first-run Vietnamese setup screen writes the settings, CEO numbers fixed. Q-003: an employee may approve on the CEO's written instruction, CEO's name recorded. Q-004: success measure is A-029 only.

Planning Gate.decided_by: orchestrator (MC-17 session), on the CEO's Scope Gate approval CEO-D-1310
Planning Gate.rationale: Plan of 28 tasks in 17 waves traces every scope item S-001..S-018 and criterion SC-01..SC-30; validator passed on attempt 2. Q-001: per CEO-D-1310 item 3 the approval carries the CEO's name and, when an employee presses approve, the employee's name and that it was on the CEO's written instruction; the architect fixes the wording inside the tool's ApprovedBy field. Q-002: no download; the installed, manifest-verified chrome-headless-shell (CEO-D-1001) with Chromium's fake media device is available for a no-microphone browser test, and the architect decides whether to use it. Q-003: as in MC-16, the orchestrator decides the Verification Gate for qa on qa's evidence.

Design Gate.rationale: CEO-D-1311: O-003 process boundary allowed (pure checks, settings validation, probe and conversion in the web process; check/script/produce/approve/verify as the MC-16 tool child with zero sockets); O-018 zero-package recording test with the installed headless shell and fake capture, SC-23 unchanged; desktop shortcut created on confirmation at first run; D-001 to D-006 accepted; approver text '[CEO name] (CEO)' or '[CEO name] (CEO; nhân viên [employee name] bấm duyệt theo chỉ thị bằng văn bản của CEO)'. Q-003 decided by the orchestrator for qa: the test browser's loopback connection to the app is not counted in SC-28's toolchain socket count.

Review Gate.rationale: Review approve-with-corrections; no critical; blocking CR-001 resolved by the CEO's decision CEO-D-1312 and serialisation in ef327e9; CR-003..CR-006 fixed in ef327e9; CR-002 recorded as a known issue; MC-16 checks unweakened.

Verification Gate.rationale: Build 0 warnings; pilot tests 251/251; web tests 36/36 twice incl. no-microphone recording test; Browser-pane demo of all seven steps incl. recording, approve and verify by hash passed; Q-002/Q-003 closed; exit-4 path untested by design (known issue).

Closure Gate.rationale: Release note RN-2026-017 validated 34/34; Vietnamese operator guide placed at pilot-affiliate-vn/mc-17/01-huong-dan-ung-dung-web.md (port note verified against Shortcut.cs: shortcut has no arguments, default port 47817); MC-16 guide points to it (K-014 closed); CEO-D-1313 deferred to MC-18 per the CEO's direct choice; all phases complete.
